zhDescription: 一支早期手铳，金属管配上木柄，便有了火器最朴素的模样。它的年代比准头更值得称道。
enDescription: An early hand cannon: a metal tube, a wooden handle, and very little refinement. Its age is more impressive than its accuracy.

zhDescription: 一支荷兰火绳枪。修长的枪管与厚重木托保留着早期军械的庄重，连收藏柜都得为它多让些地方。
enDescription: A Dutch matchlock musket with a long barrel and a substantial wooden stock. Even a collector's cabinet needs to make room for this much history.

zhDescription: 一把荷兰簧轮手枪。精巧的点火机构藏在古朴轮廓之中，足以让懂行的收藏家停下脚步。
enDescription: A Dutch wheellock pistol with intricate old-world engineering beneath its antique profile. The sort of piece that makes a knowledgeable collector stop and look.

zhDescription: 一支枪口外扩的燧发短铳。短粗的轮廓带着旅人与水手的旧日气息，摆在柜台上也很难忽视。
enDescription: A flintlock blunderbuss with a broad, flared muzzle. Its stout silhouette recalls travelers and sailors, and is difficult to overlook on a shop counter.

zhName: 布朗·贝斯燧发火枪（古董）
zhDescription: 一支布朗·贝斯燧发火枪。修长木托与朴实铁件见证了旧式步兵的时代，比亮闪闪的新货更有故事。
enDescription: A Brown Bess flintlock musket. Its long stock and plain ironwork recall an age of line infantry, with more stories to tell than a polished new arrival.

zhName: 夏勒维尔1766式燧发火枪（古董）
zhDescription: 一支法国夏勒维尔1766式燧发火枪。年代久远，制式步兵军械的利落线条仍清晰可辨。
enDescription: A French Charleville Model 1766 flintlock musket. The years have not obscured the purposeful lines of a traditional infantry arm.

zhDescription: 一把海军燧发手枪。短小枪身带着船舱与甲板的年代感，足够给一柜古董添上几分海上风情。
enDescription: A naval flintlock pistol with a compact, unmistakably old-fashioned frame. A little shipboard character for a cabinet full of landlocked antiques.

zhDescription: 一支贝克线膛步枪。朴实木托配上早期线膛设计，是英国步枪兵时代留给收藏家的纪念。
enDescription: A Baker rifle with plain wooden furniture and an early rifled barrel. A collector's keepsake from the age of British riflemen.

zhDescription: 一支霍尔M1819后装步枪。独特的枪尾结构记录着火器设计的转折，在一排前装古董中格外醒目。
enDescription: A Hall M1819 breechloading rifle. Its distinctive breech marks a turning point in firearm design and stands out in any row of muzzleloading antiques.

zhDescription: 一支德莱塞针发步枪。修长枪身保留着古典军械的模样，针发与后装设计却曾是那个时代的新风潮。
enDescription: A Dreyse needle rifle. Its long frame looks thoroughly traditional, though its needle ignition and breechloading design once represented a new age.

zhName: 柯尔特1851海军型转轮手枪（古董）
zhDescription: 一把柯尔特1851海军型转轮手枪。纤细枪管、木质握把与经典转轮，足以让古董柜台多几分风度。
enDescription: A Colt 1851 Navy revolver. A slender barrel, wooden grip and classic cylinder lend a little elegance to the antique counter.

zhDescription: 一支1841式密西西比击发步枪。厚实木托与传统军用轮廓，保留着击发枪时代的沉稳气派。
enDescription: A Model 1841 Mississippi percussion rifle. Substantial woodwork and a traditional military profile preserve the dignity of the percussion era.

zhName: 柯尔特单动军用转轮手枪
zhDescription: 一把使用.45 Colt弹药的单动转轮手枪。结实枪身与经典轮廓，让遥远的边疆在柜台前近了一步。
enDescription: A single-action revolver chambered in .45 Colt. Its sturdy frame and classic lines bring a little of the frontier to the counter.

zhDescription: 一把使用.45 ACP弹药的半自动手枪。老派、硬朗，总有人愿意为它是不是最好的手枪争上半天。
enDescription: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in .45 ACP. Old-fashioned and solidly built; someone is always willing to argue that it is still the best.

zhDescription: 一支使用.44-40 WCF弹药的杠杆步枪。木托与标志性的杠杆让它自带西部风情，无须再挂一顶牛仔帽。
enDescription: A lever-action rifle chambered in .44-40 WCF. Its wooden stock and distinctive lever provide all the frontier character; a cowboy hat is optional.

zhDescription: 一支使用7.62×54R弹药的栓动步枪。枪身修长，线条朴实，满是老式军用步枪不爱拐弯抹角的作风。
enDescription: A bolt-action rifle chambered in 7.62×54R. Long, plain and thoroughly military, with little interest in fashionable embellishments.

zhDescription: 一支使用7.92×57毛瑟弹药的栓动卡宾枪。紧凑木托与利落枪机，保留着传统军用步枪的严整气质。
enDescription: A bolt-action carbine chambered in 7.92×57 Mauser. Its compact wooden stock and clean profile retain the disciplined character of a traditional service rifle.

zhDescription: 一支使用.30-06弹药的半自动步枪。厚实木托与整装弹夹是它的经典招牌，老兵与收藏家都认得这副模样。
enDescription: A semi-automatic rifle chambered in .30-06. Its substantial wooden stock and en bloc clip give it a profile familiar to veterans and collectors alike.

zhDescription: 一支使用.45 ACP弹药的汤普森冲锋枪。厚重金属配上木制握把与枪托，带着老电影般的醒目派头。
enDescription: A Thompson submachine gun chambered in .45 ACP. Heavy metal and wooden furniture give it a presence straight out of an old film.

zhDescription: 一支使用7.62×25弹药的冲锋枪。圆鼓鼓的弹鼓与木制枪托格外醒目，看起来像是为漫长战事准备的。
enDescription: A submachine gun chambered in 7.62×25. Its round drum and wooden stock are instantly recognizable; it looks prepared for a long war.

zhName: 温彻斯特M1897泵动战壕霰弹枪
zhDescription: 一支12号口径泵动霰弹枪。短枪管与老式木托保留着战壕枪的硬派轮廓，绝不是精巧的摆设。
enDescription: A 12-gauge pump-action shotgun. Its short barrel and old-fashioned woodwork retain the blunt character of a trench gun, not a delicate display piece.

zhDescription: 一支使用.30-06弹药的自动步枪。宽厚机匣与朴实木托相当有分量，连摆进货架都像一项体力活。
enDescription: An automatic rifle chambered in .30-06. Its substantial receiver and plain wooden furniture make even stocking the shelf feel like physical labor.

zhDescription: 一挺使用7.92×57毛瑟弹药的通用机枪。长机匣与散热护套组成了极具辨识度的战场轮廓。
enDescription: A general-purpose machine gun chambered in 7.92×57 Mauser. Its long receiver and distinctive barrel shroud form an unmistakable battlefield silhouette.

zhDescription: 一支使用7.92×33 Kurz弹药的突击步枪。弧形弹匣与木托之间，藏着军用步枪迈向新时代的身影。
enDescription: An assault rifle chambered in 7.92×33 Kurz. Between its curved magazine and wooden stock lies the outline of a new era in service rifles.

zhDescription: 一支使用7.62×39毫米弹药的突击步枪。朴实、硬朗，这玩意就算到了宇宙中也随处可见。
enDescription: An assault rifle chambered in 7.62×39 mm. Plain and hard-edged; you can find these things everywhere, even out in space.

zhDescription: 一把使用9×19毫米弹药的半自动手枪。聚合物枪身与方正套筒不追求华丽，却很懂得实用二字。
enDescription: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 9×19 mm. Its polymer frame and squared slide make no attempt at grandeur, just a convincing case for practicality.

zhDescription: 一支使用5.56×45毫米弹药的突击步枪。细长枪管与固定提把，勾勒出冷战军械中熟悉的轮廓。
enDescription: An assault rifle chambered in 5.56×45 mm. A slender barrel and fixed carry handle give it a familiar Cold War profile.

zhDescription: 一支使用7.62×51毫米弹药的战斗步枪。修长而结实的全尺寸枪身，带着旧式军用长枪的庄重。
enDescription: A battle rifle chambered in 7.62×51 mm. Its long, substantial frame carries the imposing character of a full-size service rifle.

zhDescription: 一支使用9×19毫米弹药的冲锋枪。紧凑枪身配上固定枪托，在一排长枪之间显得格外利落。
enDescription: A submachine gun chambered in 9×19 mm. A compact frame and fixed stock make it look particularly tidy beside a rack of full-length rifles.

zhDescription: 一支使用5.7×28毫米弹药的个人防卫武器。顶部弹匣与圆润枪身颇有未来感，放进太空商店也毫不违和。
enDescription: A personal defense weapon chambered in 5.7×28 mm. Its top-mounted magazine and rounded frame look futuristic enough to feel at home in a spaceborne shop.

zhName: 史密斯威森629型转轮手枪（6英寸）
zhDescription: 一把使用.44 Magnum弹药的转轮手枪。亮眼金属与修长枪管很有派头，精致的外表并不代表温柔。
enDescription: A revolver chambered in .44 Magnum. Bright metal and a long barrel give it plenty of presence; a refined appearance need not imply a gentle disposition.

zhName: 雷明顿870泵动霰弹枪（短枪管型）
zhDescription: 一支12号口径泵动霰弹枪。结实枪身与短枪管朴实无华，很适合不喜欢花哨货色的买家。
enDescription: A 12-gauge pump-action shotgun. Solid construction and a short barrel keep things straightforward, for buyers with little patience for frills.

zhDescription: 一支使用7.62×51毫米弹药的栓动狙击步枪。沉稳枪身更衬耐心的射手，而不是急着讨价还价的收藏家。
enDescription: A bolt-action sniper rifle chambered in 7.62×51 mm. Its restrained profile suits a patient marksman better than an impatient bargain hunter.

zhName: 巴雷特M82A1大口径半自动步枪
zhDescription: 一支使用.50 BMG弹药的大口径半自动步枪。尺寸与气势都不容小觑，小店摆放前最好先腾一腾柜台。
enDescription: A large-caliber semi-automatic rifle chambered in .50 BMG. Neither its size nor its presence is modest; a small shop should clear some counter space first.

zhDescription: 一挺使用5.56×45毫米弹药的班用机枪。厚实机匣与军用轮廓，让它在货架上也像随时等待队伍集合。
enDescription: A squad automatic weapon chambered in 5.56×45 mm. Its substantial receiver and military profile look ready for the squad to form up, even on a shop shelf.

zhDescription: 一挺使用7.62×51毫米弹药的通用机枪。粗犷外形与十足分量，让搬货的人比买家更早记住它。
enDescription: A general-purpose machine gun chambered in 7.62×51 mm. Its rugged frame and considerable bulk make an impression on the stock clerk before the customer.

zhName: 鲁格Mark IV标准型靶射手枪
enName: Ruger Mark IV Standard Target Pistol
zhDescription: 一把小口径靶射手枪。细长枪管与简洁轮廓透着专注，比起张扬外观，它更适合安静的靶场时光。
enDescription: A small-caliber target pistol. Its slender barrel and clean lines suggest quiet time at the range rather than a taste for extravagant appearances.

zhDescription: 一把小口径半自动手枪。轻巧枪身与紧凑轮廓，让摆满大块头的柜台也能为它留出一席之地。
enDescription: A small-caliber semi-automatic pistol. Its light, compact frame can find a place on a counter already crowded with larger hardware.

zhDescription: 一把小口径靶射手枪。木质握把为利落枪身添上几分传统气质，是柜台上一件耐看的小物。
enDescription: A small-caliber target pistol. A wooden grip adds a traditional touch to its purposeful frame, making it a pleasing piece for the counter.

zhDescription: 一支小口径半自动步枪。木制枪托与轻巧枪身少了军械的锋芒，多了休闲靶场的轻松气息。
enDescription: A small-caliber semi-automatic rifle. Its wooden stock and light frame trade military severity for the relaxed character of a recreational range gun.

zhName: 温彻斯特37型单管霰弹枪
zhDescription: 一支使用12/70霰弹的单管单发霰弹枪。木托与朴实枪身没有多余装饰，是老派实用主义的代表。
enDescription: A single-barrel, single-shot shotgun chambered in 12/70. Plain woodwork and an unadorned frame make a convincing case for old-fashioned practicality.

zhDescription: 一把使用.45 ACP弹药的单发手枪。外形粗陋得近乎吝啬，却凭着鲜明来历成为收藏柜里惹人好奇的一件。
enDescription: A single-shot pistol chambered in .45 ACP. Almost miserly in its construction, yet its unusual heritage makes it a conversation piece in a collector's cabinet.

zhName: 邦德武器得克萨斯卫士双管德林杰手枪
enName: Bond Arms Texas Defender Double-Barrel Derringer
zhDescription: 一把使用.45 Colt弹药的双管德林杰手枪。短小枪身叠着两根枪管，尺寸不大，派头倒不小。
enDescription: A double-barrel derringer chambered in .45 Colt. Two stacked barrels in a very small frame; modest dimensions, decidedly less modest character.

zhDescription: 一把使用7.62×25毫米托卡列夫弹药的半自动手枪。纤细而硬朗的外形，保留着旧式军械的简洁作风。
enDescription: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 7.62×25 mm Tokarev. Its slim, hard-edged profile retains the no-nonsense character of an older service arm.

zhDescription: 一支使用7.62×54R弹药的半自动步枪。修长木托与醒目护木带着旧式军用长枪的气派，摆上架便很占眼缘。
enDescription: A semi-automatic rifle chambered in 7.62×54R. A long wooden stock and distinctive handguard give it the presence of a classic service rifle.

zhName: 斯普林菲尔德M1903栓动步枪
zhDescription: 一支使用.30-06 Springfield弹药的栓动步枪。修长木托与传统枪机勾勒出端正轮廓，颇受老派收藏家青睐。
enDescription: A bolt-action rifle chambered in .30-06 Springfield. Its long wooden stock and traditional bolt give it the dignified profile favored by old-school collectors.

zhDescription: 一把使用9×19毫米弹药的半自动手枪。开放式套筒与圆润线条颇具辨识度，实用之外也有几分意式风度。
enDescription: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 9×19 mm. An open-top slide and rounded lines lend a little Italian elegance to a thoroughly practical sidearm.

zhName: 西蒙诺夫SKS半自动卡宾枪
zhDescription: 一支使用7.62×39毫米弹药的半自动卡宾枪。厚实木托与利落轮廓，让它在老式步枪和现代军械之间自成一格。
enDescription: A semi-automatic carbine chambered in 7.62×39 mm. Substantial woodwork and a tidy profile give it a character poised between traditional rifles and modern service arms.

zhName: 鲁格Mini-14牧场型半自动步枪
zhDescription: 一支使用5.56×45毫米NATO弹药的半自动步枪。木托与紧凑枪身相映成趣，带着几分牧场工具般的朴实气质。
enDescription: A semi-automatic rifle chambered in 5.56×45 mm NATO. A wooden stock and compact frame give it the unpretentious character of a well-kept ranch tool.

zhDescription: 一支使用9×19毫米弹药的冲锋枪。折叠枪托与冷峻金属线条，使它在一排木托老枪中格外显眼。
enDescription: A submachine gun chambered in 9×19 mm. Its folding stock and austere metal lines stand apart from a rack of wood-stocked contemporaries.

zhDescription: 一支使用5.56×45毫米NATO弹药的卡宾枪。紧凑枪身与伸缩枪托带着鲜明的现代军械风格，适合偏爱利落造型的买家。
enDescription: A carbine chambered in 5.56×45 mm NATO. A compact frame and telescoping stock give it a distinctly modern military look for buyers who favor purposeful lines.

zhDescription: 来自《毁灭战士》的虚构能量狙击枪。庞大的枪身与科幻轮廓极具压迫感，是足以独占一层货架的跨界收藏品。
enDescription: A fictional energy sniper rifle from DOOM. Its massive frame and imposing science-fiction silhouette make it a crossover collectible worthy of a shelf all to itself.

zhDescription: 一包扎好的火药与弹丸。纸张已泛黄，收藏者仍能闻出旧时代的硝烟。
enDescription: A tied packet of powder and shot. The paper has yellowed, but a collector can still catch a whiff of another age.

zhDescription: 结实纸盒里装着常见的中间威力弹。它的身影和那支弯弹匣步枪一样，遍布各个角落。
enDescription: 7.62×39 mm Ammunition. A sturdy carton of familiar intermediate cartridges. Almost as widespread as the curved-magazine rifle they are associated with.

zhDescription: 一盒9×19毫米帕拉贝鲁姆弹药。包装朴素，却是柜台上很少缺席的熟面孔。
enDescription: 9×19 mm Ammunition. A box of 9×19 mm Parabellum cartridges. Plain packaging, and a familiar sight on almost any weapons counter.

zhDescription: 一盒轻巧尖头的步枪弹药。军用标签已经磨损，口径标记依然清晰。
enDescription: 5.56×45 mm NATO Ammunition. A carton of slender rifle cartridges. The military label is worn, but the caliber marking remains legible.

zhDescription: 一批分量扎实的全威力步枪弹。隔着纸盒，也能感到老式军械的沉稳。
enDescription: 7.62×51 mm NATO Ammunition. A substantial batch of full-power rifle cartridges. Even through the carton, they carry the weight of traditional military hardware.

zhDescription: 小口径的细长弹药，整齐排列在包装里。尺寸特别，挑选买家时也格外讲究。
enDescription: 5.7×28 mm Ammunition. Slender small-caliber cartridges arranged neatly in their packaging. An unusual size for a more particular buyer.

zhDescription: 一盒黄铜底缘醒目的大口径转轮枪弹。光看包装，就知道它不是温和的收藏。
enDescription: .44 Magnum Ammunition. A box of large revolver cartridges with prominent brass rims. Even the packaging suggests an assertive collection.

zhDescription: 一盒12/70规格霰弹。结实的壳体和清楚的标识，让老派猎具柜显得更完整。
enDescription: 12-Gauge Shells (12/70). A box of 12/70 shotgun shells. Stout cases and clear markings complete a traditional sporting-gun display.

zhDescription: 一批尺寸惊人的大口径步枪弹。摆在柜台上时，旁边的商品都会显得小巧几分。
enDescription: .50 BMG Ammunition. An imposing batch of large rifle cartridges. Everything else on the counter seems smaller beside them.

zhDescription: 带底缘的经典转轮枪弹，透着边疆年代的老派气息。
enDescription: .45 Colt Ammunition. Classic rimmed revolver cartridges with a distinctly frontier-era character.

zhDescription: 一批短而粗壮的手枪弹。朴素可靠的外形，早已成为经典的一部分。
enDescription: .45 ACP Ammunition. A batch of short, stout pistol cartridges. Their unassuming appearance has long since become part of the classic.

zhDescription: 一盒带瓶颈的老式弹药。和温彻斯特杠杆机构一样，深得怀旧买家欢心。
enDescription: .44-40 WCF Ammunition. A box of old-fashioned bottleneck cartridges. Like the Winchester lever action, they appeal to nostalgic buyers.

zhDescription: 底缘突出的长寿军用步枪弹。包装换过许多回，轮廓却始终熟悉。
enDescription: 7.62×54R Ammunition. Long-serving military rifle cartridges with pronounced rims. The packaging has changed many times; the silhouette has not.

zhDescription: 一批线条修长的毛瑟步枪弹。老军械收藏里常能找到它们的位置。
enDescription: 7.92×57 mm Mauser Ammunition. A batch of slender Mauser rifle cartridges. There is usually a place for them in an old military collection.

zhDescription: 一盒经典军用步枪弹。黄铜与纸板的组合，带着熟悉的军需仓库气息。
enDescription: .30-06 Springfield Ammunition. A carton of classic military rifle cartridges. Brass and cardboard lend it the familiar character of a quartermaster's store.

zhDescription: 一批小巧的瓶颈手枪弹。分量不大，却很容易引起老式冲锋枪收藏者的注意。
enDescription: 7.62×25 mm Tokarev Ammunition. A compact batch of bottleneck pistol cartridges. A small parcel that readily catches the eye of a vintage submachine-gun collector.

zhDescription: 一盒短弹壳的中间威力弹。短短的外形，见证了军用步枪设计的一次转向。
enDescription: 7.92×33 mm Kurz Ammunition. A box of short-cased intermediate cartridges. Their compact form marks a turning point in military rifle design.

zhDescription: 适配AK-47的弹匣。弯曲的钢制外壳磨得发亮，仍保留着粗犷的军用线条。
enDescription: A magazine for the AK-47. Its curved steel shell is polished by wear, retaining a rugged military outline.

zhDescription: 适配格洛克17的弹匣。外形简洁的可拆卸弹匣，没有多余装饰。
enDescription: A magazine for the GLOCK 17. A plain detachable magazine with little interest in ornament.

zhDescription: 适配M16A1的弹匣。轻薄的金属壳体与那副细长枪身十分相称。
enDescription: A magazine for the M16A1. A light metal shell that complements the rifle's slender frame.

zhDescription: 适配FN FAL的弹匣。厚实的方形弹匣，带着全尺寸战斗步枪的分量。
enDescription: A magazine for the FN FAL. A substantial box magazine with the heft of a full-sized battle rifle.

zhDescription: 适配MP5的弹匣。修长的弧形轮廓，是这支冲锋枪的熟悉搭档。
enDescription: A magazine for the MP5. Its slender curved outline is a familiar companion to this submachine gun.

zhDescription: 适配P90的弹匣。狭长的顶部弹匣，独特造型让它很难与别的配件混淆。
enDescription: A magazine for the P90. An elongated top-mounted magazine with a shape that is difficult to mistake.

zhDescription: 适配巴雷特M82A1的弹匣。厚重的外壳像是为大尺寸弹药量身定做的。
enDescription: A magazine for the Barrett M82A1. Its heavy shell looks made to match the rifle's imposing cartridges.

zhDescription: 与M249配套的弹链供弹组件。金属环节排列整齐，颇受军械收藏者青睐。
enDescription: A belt-feed assembly for the M249. Neatly arranged metal links appeal to military-hardware collectors.

zhDescription: 一套与M60配套的弹链组件。沉甸甸的金属环节，给柜台添了几分前线仓库的气息。
enDescription: A belt assembly for the M60. Its weighty links lend the counter something of a field armory's atmosphere.

zhDescription: 适配鲁格Mark IV的弹匣。细长而轻巧，和靶射手枪一样朴实利落。
enDescription: A magazine for the Ruger Mark IV. Slender and light, as straightforward as the target pistol it accompanies.

zhDescription: 适配瓦尔特P22的弹匣。小巧的壳体，适合放在紧凑手枪的配件旁。
enDescription: A magazine for the Walther P22. A compact shell at home beside a small pistol's accessories.

zhDescription: 适配勃朗宁Buck Mark的弹匣。窄长的外形带着靶场用品惯有的整洁。
enDescription: A magazine for the Browning Buck Mark. Its narrow shape has the tidy appearance of familiar range equipment.

zhDescription: 适配鲁格10/22的弹匣。紧凑的供弹部件，正好衬托出步枪的轻巧。
enDescription: A magazine for the Ruger 10/22. A compact feed component that suits the rifle's light proportions.

zhDescription: 适配M1911的弹匣。平直的金属外壳，有着经典手枪配件的低调。
enDescription: A magazine for the M1911. A straight metal shell with the understated character of a classic pistol accessory.

zhDescription: 适配汤普森M1928A1的弹匣。沉稳的长方形外壳，与厚重枪身很是相配。
enDescription: A magazine for the Thompson M1928A1. A solid rectangular shell well matched to the weighty firearm.

zhDescription: 适配PPSh-41的弹匣。圆鼓鼓的金属壳体格外醒目，是这支冲锋枪的经典轮廓。
enDescription: A magazine for the PPSh-41. Its round metal body forms an unmistakable part of this submachine gun's classic outline.

zhDescription: 适配BAR M1918的弹匣。结实的方形弹匣，军用磨痕比装饰更显眼。
enDescription: A magazine for the BAR M1918. A stout box magazine whose service wear stands out more than any decoration.

zhDescription: 适配StG 44的弹匣。长而弯曲的金属轮廓，带着早期突击步枪的独特气质。
enDescription: A magazine for the StG 44. A long curved metal profile with the distinctive character of an early assault rifle.

zhDescription: 一枚莫辛步枪的五发桥夹。薄薄一片金属，也能成为老军械收藏里不可少的细节。
enDescription: A five-round stripper clip for a Mosin rifle. A thin piece of metal, but a telling detail in a vintage collection.

zhDescription: 一枚毛瑟步枪的五发桥夹。朴素的小零件，和栓动步枪一样经得住岁月。
enDescription: A five-round Mauser stripper clip. A modest accessory with the same enduring character as a bolt-action rifle.

enName: M1 Garand Eight-Round En Bloc Clip
zhDescription: 一枚M1加兰德的八发整装弹夹。外形简单，在收藏者眼里却有独特的声响与故事。
enDescription: An eight-round en bloc clip for the M1 Garand. Simple in shape, yet rich in familiar sounds and stories for a collector.

zhDescription: 一条供MG 42使用的弹链。连续的金属环节，为收藏柜添上沉重的军械细节。
enDescription: An ammunition belt for the MG 42. A line of metal links adding a weighty military detail to a collection.

zhDescription: 小巧的红点瞄具，给适配枪械添上一点利落的现代气息。提升精度与卖相，不拖累操持。
enDescription: A compact red dot sight gives compatible firearms a crisp, modern look. It improves accuracy and style without a handling penalty.

zhDescription: 方正的全息瞄具很有战术派头，精度也比基础红点更出色。额外的分量让适配枪械稍显笨拙。
enDescription: This boxy holographic sight brings tactical flair and more accuracy than a basic red dot. The extra bulk makes compatible firearms a little less handy.

zhDescription: 一支外形紧凑的低倍变焦镜，为适配枪械增加精度与几分专业气质。镜身虽短，仍要占去一些操持余裕。
enDescription: A compact low-power variable scope adds accuracy and a professional air to compatible firearms. Even a short optic takes a little away from handling.

zhDescription: 长长的高倍镜让适配枪械有了精密射击的架势，精度提升也相当可观。沉重镜身换来的代价是更费力的操持。
enDescription: This long high-power scope gives compatible firearms a precision-rifle silhouette and a substantial accuracy boost. Its weight demands a larger sacrifice in handling.

zhDescription: 精密镜体与电子组件挤在一起，科技感和精度同样抢眼。适配枪械的操持负担也随之加重，体面从来不轻巧。
enDescription: Precision optics and electronics share a crowded housing, bringing impressive accuracy and high-tech style. Compatible firearms become harder to handle; sophistication is not lightweight.

zhDescription: 长枪用合成枪托，朴素外壳省去了不少累赘。操持更轻快，后坐控制也略有改善。
enDescription: A plain synthetic stock for long guns that sheds unnecessary bulk. It improves handling and offers a modest gain in recoil control.

zhDescription: 棱角分明的长枪枪托，兼顾战术卖相、操持和后坐控制。没有夸张的专长，却也不必为某一项牺牲另一项。
enDescription: An angular long-gun stock that balances tactical style, handling, and recoil control. It has no extravagant specialty and asks for no trade-off between them.

zhDescription: 厚实的长枪枪托，把分量花在后坐控制上。稳定得很有底气，操持起来也确实沉重。
enDescription: A thick long-gun stock that puts its weight into recoil control. Reassuringly steady, and every bit as cumbersome as it looks.

zhDescription: 轮廓讲究的长枪枪托，为精度与后坐控制留足了余地。它更中意沉稳的枪身，而不是轻巧的操持。
enDescription: A carefully shaped long-gun stock that favors accuracy and recoil control. It prefers a steady weapon to effortless handling.

zhDescription: 一只干净利落的长枪下挂握把，把心思全用在改善操持上。没有花哨外壳，也不抢其他配件的风头。
enDescription: A neat underbarrel grip for long guns, devoted entirely to better handling. No showy housing, and no attempt to steal the rest of the gun's thunder.

zhDescription: 棱线鲜明的长枪握把，让外观、后坐控制和操持一起受益。战术味够浓，代价倒不苛刻。
enDescription: A sharply contoured long-gun grip that improves style, recoil control, and handling together. Plenty of tactical character without an awkward trade-off.

zhDescription: 低矮的斜角轮廓贴在长枪下方，着重改善操持。精度也沾上一点光，幅度虽小，总比没有强。
enDescription: A low-profile angled grip beneath a long gun, focused on easier handling. Accuracy gets a small bonus too; a little is better than nothing.

zhDescription: 结实得近乎固执的长枪握把，明显加强后坐控制。额外的厚重感也让整枪不那么灵便。
enDescription: An almost stubbornly solid long-gun grip that substantially improves recoil control. Its extra heft makes the weapon less nimble.

zhDescription: 长枪下方的庞然大物，火力、卖相和后坐控制都颇有分量。操持上的沉重负担同样醒目，枪身很难再显得轻盈。
enDescription: A hulking addition beneath a compatible long gun, with substantial gains in firepower, style, and recoil control. The severe handling penalty is just as conspicuous.

zhDescription: 紧凑的霰弹枪挂在适配长枪下方，为整枪增添火力和粗犷卖相。多出来的块头让操持明显吃力。
enDescription: A compact shotgun beneath a compatible long gun adds firepower and rugged style. All that extra bulk takes a clear toll on handling.

zhDescription: 紧凑的灯体挂在长枪下方，添上几分整备齐全的气派。卖相与操持都有小幅提升，朴素却讨喜。
enDescription: A compact light housing gives a long gun a fully outfitted look. Modest improvements to style and handling make it an unassuming favorite.

zhDescription: 小巧的激光模块让长枪看起来更干练，操持也更顺手。它的本钱在卖相与手感，而不是精度。
enDescription: A compact laser module gives a long gun a sharper look and easier handling. Its strengths are style and feel, rather than accuracy.

zhDescription: 朴实的枪口附件，为适配枪械带来可靠的后坐控制提升和一点硬朗卖相。操持略有损失，算不上沉重负担。
enDescription: A plain muzzle fitting that improves recoil control and adds a little rugged style to compatible firearms. The handling cost is present, but modest.

zhDescription: 比标准款更有存在感的制退器，后坐控制与卖相也更出色。适配枪械要为这份沉稳付出更多操持上的代价。
enDescription: A more prominent brake with stronger recoil control and a sharper look than the standard model. Compatible firearms pay a larger handling cost for that composure.

zhDescription: 线条简练的枪口附件，给适配枪械收出一个利落的轮廓。略增卖相与操持，不靠夸张性能抢眼。
enDescription: A clean-lined muzzle fitting that neatly finishes a compatible firearm's profile. Small gains in style and handling are its quiet selling points.

zhDescription: 棱角更鲜明的消焰器，让适配枪械的枪口多些战术气息。卖相与操持的提升都比标准款更足。
enDescription: A more angular flash hider that lends a compatible firearm some tactical character. Both its style and handling bonuses exceed the standard model's.

zhDescription: 做工粗糙的消音附件，连卖相都透着凑合劲。适配枪械的后坐控制略有改善，可靠性与操持却要一起让步。
enDescription: A rough suppressor whose appearance makes no secret of its improvised origins. Compatible firearms gain a little recoil control at the expense of style, reliability, and handling.

zhDescription: 规整的消音器外壳，为适配枪械添上低调而昂贵的气质。卖相与后坐控制都得到改善，操持则稍受拖累。
enDescription: A neatly finished suppressor gives compatible firearms an understated, expensive look. It improves style and recoil control with a small handling penalty.

zhDescription: 霰弹枪专用的全喉缩，偏爱紧凑而集中的表现。精度提升比半喉缩更大，操持则略逊一筹。
enDescription: A shotgun-only full choke with a taste for tighter performance. It offers more accuracy than the half choke, with a small handling penalty.

zhDescription: 霰弹枪专用的半喉缩，给精度添一份适中的补益。没有全喉缩那样突出，却也不牺牲操持。
enDescription: A shotgun-only half choke that provides a moderate accuracy boost. Less pronounced than a full choke, but with no loss of handling.

zhDescription: 细节收拾得更妥帖的扳机组件，为适配枪械补上可靠性与操持。外表不张扬，功夫都在基本功里。
enDescription: A tidier trigger assembly that improves reliability and handling on compatible firearms. Unassuming on the outside, attentive to the fundamentals.

zhDescription: 一套做工讲究的扳机组件，在可靠性与操持上比基础优化款更进一步。适配枪械不必靠花哨外观证明身价。
enDescription: A finely finished trigger assembly that goes beyond the refined model in both reliability and handling. Compatible firearms need no flashy exterior to justify the upgrade.

zhDescription: 竞赛取向的扳机组件，为适配枪械争取更好的操持与精度。可靠性略有退让，挑剔也是它性格的一部分。
enDescription: A competition-minded trigger assembly that favors handling and accuracy on compatible firearms. Reliability slips a little; a demanding temperament comes with the package.

zhDescription: 一套让适配枪械重拾整洁卖相的清洁用品，老旧外表也能精神几分。光鲜不等于修复，可靠性不会因此提高。
enDescription: Cleaning supplies that restore a tidy appearance to compatible firearms, even those looking their age. A good shine is not a repair, and reliability stays unchanged.

zhDescription: 给适配枪械披上一层冷亮的银色，让朴素轮廓也有几分贵气。提升的是卖相，不是火力。
enDescription: A cool silver finish lends even a plain compatible firearm a touch of refinement. The improvement is in style, not firepower.

zhDescription: 张扬的金色外衣，专为不愿淹没在货架里的适配枪械准备。卖相比镀银更抢眼，火力却不会被金光抬高。
enDescription: An ostentatious gold finish for compatible firearms that refuse to disappear on a shelf. More style than silver plating, without a single extra point of firepower.

zhDescription: Winchester 37 专用的古怪附件，灵感来自历史上的 Alofs 自动装填构想。它以可靠性与操持换取火力，也带着违禁品的麻烦。
enDescription: An eccentric Winchester 37 exclusive inspired by the historical Alofs loading concept. It trades reliability and handling for firepower, along with the trouble of contraband status.

zhDescription: M1911 专用枪托，让这把老派手枪显出不同寻常的轮廓。后坐控制与精度有所提升，操持受限，违禁身份也不容忽视。
enDescription: An M1911-exclusive stock that gives the old service pistol an unusual silhouette. It improves recoil control and accuracy at a handling cost, with contraband status to consider.

zhDescription: GLOCK 17 专用的违禁转换附件，小体积藏着极端的取舍。火力大幅提升，可靠性下降，后坐控制更是代价惨重。
enDescription: A contraband conversion attachment exclusive to the GLOCK 17, with extreme compromises in a small package. Firepower rises sharply, while reliability falls and recoil control suffers severely.

zhDescription: Springfield M1903 专用的历史奇物，名字来自一战时期的佩德森装置。火力的增长要用可靠性与精度交换，且属于违禁配件。
enDescription: A historical curiosity exclusive to the Springfield M1903, named after the First World War Pedersen device. This contraband attachment trades reliability and accuracy for firepower.

zhDescription: SKS 专用的违禁枪托，性格比外形更激进。火力有所增长，可靠性、后坐控制和精度却都得付账。
enDescription: A contraband stock exclusive to the SKS, with a temperament more aggressive than its silhouette. Firepower improves, but reliability, recoil control, and accuracy all pay the bill.

zhDescription: 枪匠的夜班搭档。置于自有物品栏，装入并开启电源；将自有材料拆成单件投入，折为储量。每份金属锭按六档纯度由低到高兑换75/85/100/125/150/300，普通电子元件25、打印耗材25、核废料500；各类上限5000，超额不收。选择配方与数量（1–99）后点开始：通常1–2件1晚、3–6件2晚、7件以上3晚，弹壳堆与弹头堆任意批均1晚。每个有效工作夜耗8电，缺电暂停；输出满时余货保留待取。核废料仅作封存储备，不参与加工。
enDescription: A gunsmith's night-shift partner. Keep it in your own inventory, insert and switch on a power source, then deposit materials you own one item at a time to build reserves. Each ingot yields 75/85/100/125/150/300 metal, from lowest to highest purity; common electronics and printer material yield 25 each, nuclear waste 500. Each reserve caps at 5000; excess deposits are refused. Select a recipe and quantity (1–99), then Start: normally 1–2 items take 1 night, 3–6 take 2, and 7+ take 3; case and projectile batches always take 1 night. Each working night uses 8 power; insufficient power pauses work. A full output holds remaining goods for later collection. Nuclear waste is a sealed reserve, not a production input.

zhDescription: 让散装零件各归其位的弹药作坊。置于自有物品栏，装入并开启电源；将自有材料拆成单件投入。每份无烟火药和底火、弹壳堆、弹头堆各兑换对应储量100，核废料500；各类上限5000，超额不收。选择配方与数量（1–99）后点开始，任意批量均需1个有效工作夜、整批8电；缺电暂停，输出满时余货保留待取。核废料仅作封存储备，不参与加工。
enDescription: An ammunition workshop that puts loose components to work. Keep it in your own inventory, insert and switch on a power source, then deposit materials you own one item at a time. Each pack of smokeless powder and primers, pile of cases or pile of projectiles adds 100 to its matching reserve; nuclear waste adds 500. Each reserve caps at 5000; excess deposits are refused. Select a recipe and quantity (1–99), then Start. Any batch takes 1 working night and 8 power total; insufficient power pauses work. A full output holds remaining goods for later collection. Nuclear waste is a sealed reserve, not a production input.

zhDescription: 一座紧凑的小型枪架，让几件心头好不必再挤在地上。内有8×6格，仅收武器；格数不是可存枪数。
enDescription: A compact rack that keeps a few prized weapons off the floor. An 8×6-cell interior accepts weapons only; cells do not equal weapon capacity.

zhDescription: 一座横向展开的中型枪架，为渐成规模的收藏留出位置。内有20×6格，仅收武器；格数不是可存枪数。
enDescription: A broad rack with room for a growing collection. A 20×6-cell interior accepts weapons only; cells do not equal weapon capacity.

zhDescription: 一座铺开便颇有阵势的大型枪架，像是给整面收藏墙打的底。内有30×6格，仅收武器；格数不是可存枪数。
enDescription: An expansive rack fit to anchor a wall of collected arms. A 30×6-cell interior accepts weapons only; cells do not equal weapon capacity.

zhDescription: 一只专收枪械改装件的箱子，免得小零件总在最需要时失踪。内有8×12格，仅收枪械配件，不收普通材料。
enDescription: A box for firearm modifications, so small parts stop disappearing when needed most. An 8×12-cell interior accepts gun modifications only, not ordinary materials.

zhDescription: 一只专收弹药的箱子，让柜台不再到处散着弹药包。内有8×12格，仅收成品弹药，不收火药、弹壳堆或弹头堆。
enDescription: A dedicated box that keeps ammunition packs from taking over the counter. An 8×12-cell interior accepts finished ammunition only, not powder, case piles or projectile piles.

zhDescription: 一截短小敦实的枪管坯件，切口与外壁已加工整齐。可收藏或交易，不能直接装到枪械上。
enDescription: A short, stout barrel blank with neatly machined ends and outer walls. A collectible or trade good; it cannot be fitted to a firearm.

zhDescription: 一根长度适中的枪管坯件，规整的金属轮廓颇有工坊气息。可收藏或交易，不能直接装到枪械上。
enDescription: A medium-length barrel blank with the clean metal profile of a workshop product. A collectible or trade good; it cannot be fitted to a firearm.

zhDescription: 一根修长的枪管坯件，摆在架上很难不引人注意。可收藏或交易，不能直接装到枪械上。
enDescription: A long, slender barrel blank that is hard to overlook on a shelf. A collectible or trade good; it cannot be fitted to a firearm.

zhDescription: 一瓶封装的无烟火药，配着一盒整齐收好的底火。自有单件投入弹药制造台可兑换100火药与底火储量；是加工材料，不能直接当弹药使用。
enDescription: A sealed bottle of smokeless powder paired with a neatly packed box of primers. Deposit one owned item into the Ammunition Workbench for 100 powder-and-primer reserve. A production material, not usable ammunition.

zhDescription: 一堆规格混杂的空弹壳，金属边缘碰在一起叮当作响。自有单件投入弹药制造台可兑换100弹壳储量；只是加工材料，不是成品弹药。
enDescription: An assortment of empty cartridge cases whose metal rims clink together. Deposit one owned pile into the Ammunition Workbench for 100 case reserve. A production material, not finished ammunition.

zhDescription: 一堆规格混杂的弹头，小小的金属尖头挤成一团。自有单件投入弹药制造台可兑换100弹头储量；只是加工材料，不是成品弹药。
enDescription: An assortment of loose projectiles, their small metal tips crowded together. Deposit one owned pile into the Ammunition Workbench for 100 projectile reserve. A production material, not finished ammunition.

zhDescription: 一张印着整齐工业纹样的名片。和平余量工业，电话75284——为了和平，请适量囤货。
enDescription: A business card bearing a tidy industrial design. Peace Margin Industries; phone 75284. For peace's sake, stock up in moderation.
